data: {{Top|ca|legends=Unidentified Mon Calamari pilot|notoc=1}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:IkaSulko.jpg]] |name=Ika Sulko |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Mon Calamari]]''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Orange]] |skin=Brown mottle |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] **[[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Ika Sulko''' was a [[Mon Calamari]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who [[Pilot|flew]] an [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]]. His ability to operate within the [[Starfighter|fighter's]] rotatable [[cockpit]] was heightened due to his inherent kinesthetic sense. He [[Clothing|wore]] a [[Color|green]] [[flight suit]] and a [[Flight helmet|helmet]] while in his [[B-wing heavy assault starfighter|B-wing]], and he had orange [[eye]]s as well as brown mottle skin. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Fried calamari tonight!|Tim Rose, during filming of the deleted scene|{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Complete Saga|scene=Battle of Endor: Lost Rebels}}}} Ika Sulko was created for a scene in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], that was ultimately [[Content cut from Star Wars|deleted]]. He was first pictured in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]'' magazine,{{HelmetCollectionCite|67|Helmets}} published on [[October 10]], [[2017]]{{HCdatesFR|67}} and written by [[Iain Lowson]].{{EmailCite|email=File:HCSV-Email-2025-07-26.png|author=[[Iain Lowson]]|date=2025-07-26}} He was then identified in the [[2019]] reference book ''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]'', written by [[Ryder Windham]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Unidentified Mon Calamari pilot|pilot]] was first mentioned outside of his deleted scene in his [[2012]] [[Hasbro]] action figure, released as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection]]'' line.{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#091: Rebel Pilot (Mon Calamari)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/mon_cal_pilot_deleted.asp}} Footage of the scene was first revealed in a trailer for the ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'' box set at [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|Comic-Con International]] in [[2011]].{{SWArchive|url=video/view/001267.html|text=Video: Comic-Con 2011 ''Star Wars'' Blu-ray Deleted Scenes Teaser}} In the scene, Sulko says several lines as they are given to [[Tim Rose]], the puppeteer for [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]] in the film.{{EmailCite|email=File:TimRoseEmail.jpg|creator=[[Tim Rose]]|date=2021-03-11}} Many of the lines were given to other rebel pilots whose roles were cut as well, including a [[Sullustan]] and a [[human]]. Among others, the lines included mentioning that he was in range, that he was losing power, as well as a warning to stay clear, as a nearby [[starship]] was going to explode. Rose utilized the same puppet that was used to film closeup shots for Sulko on the face of Admiral Ackbar. ==Appearances== *{{Film|VI}} {{Del}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'' *{{HelmetCollectionCite|67|Helmets}} {{1stp}} *''[[Rebel Starfighters Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' {{1stID|Ika Sulko}} *{{SW|url=news/jedi-at-40-deleted-scenes|text=''Jedi'' at 40 | A Guide to Star Wars: Return of the Jedi's Deleted Scenes}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Ika Sulko |es=Ika Sulko |ja=イカ・サルコ }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Sulko, Ika}} [[Category:Alliance Starfighter Corps personnel]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Mon Calamari]]
